note: EXPECTED FAILURES, not passes. Each entry is a construct that RUNS its payload (bash adjudicated) while the classifier rates it low/medium. The gate fails on any under-block NOT listed here, so a new bypass breaks the build from day one while these do not block anyone. Every fix SHRINKS this list and the shrink is the evidence. Kept separate from the over-block baseline on purpose: merged, a fix could trade one for the other silently.
